about_the_game:
PRIVATE TESTING IS IN PROGRESS. Content you see is subject to HEAVY polish.

Heavily inspired by the flash game Amorphous+. 

____________________________________________________________

OVERVIEW

You play as Brigand, a researcher given an experimental weapon by her company's military division. She must cut through and search the nearby nests by force in hopes of finding something that will end her company's stagnating war, whether it be a simple resource or the secret workings of a completely different organization.

Within these nests are many different Anobrites, which are slimes with chitin parts. Each species has its own behavior and abilities, and they can mutate into completely different species by combining with others.

Brigand's moveset consists of a simple slash, punch, and dash. Each ability has its own properties and variants depending on when it is used, giving the tools needed to take on any situation. Additionally, specific tricks and combos (such as killing multiple Anobrites with one swing) reward the player with extra dash meter.


____________________________________________________________

GAMEPLAY

Brigand automatically moves and aims towards the player's cursor, rewarding mastery with smooth and precise gameplay (though there will be controller support for a conventional 1-stick experience). There are also very few ways to get i-frames; movement and positioning is key to avoid getting hit.

To beat a nest, the player simply kills enemies until the enemy count reaches 0. After defeating the boss that spawns at that point, the player beats the nest and can move on to the next one.

Bonus modes include an endless mode for each nest after clearing their normal mode and a boss rush after the last nest is completed.

name: MuteX+

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-9100F / AMD Ryzen 3 3100X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: MuteX+ is a slasher challenge that focuses on dynamic and varied enemies. Make the most out of a moveset built around a slash, punch, and dash to cleave through the six Anobrite nests -- each ending with their own boss -- while knocking out a fun list of achievements.
